svg.title: A solar-system portrait: Diwakar Venkat Peddada at the centre, five language planets in orbit, and the projects marked as moons.
svg.desc: A dark orbital chart. The name Diwakar Venkat Peddada sits on the left; on the right, an avatar of Diwakar is the sun, with Python, C#, Rust, TypeScript and C++ drawn as planets on five orbits. Small moon dots stand in for the projects built on top of them.

g.text: I build the layer between a live signal
and the person waiting for it.
